ad_intro:
Why a performance-marketing audit includes the website: Meta does not make you money - the click does. You pay CPL on the ad; the conversion happens on the landing page, the form, WhatsApp speed-to-lead and the proof. If the ad says 'Go solar with V-Guard' and the click lands on a page that says 'Due to technical upgradation of our system, our website is temporarily not accessible', you rented the click and lost the lead. That is the whole job of this audit - ads, site, form, creative and tracking as one funnel.

V-Guard Industries Ltd (NSE/BSE VGUARD, founded 1977 by Kochouseph Chittilappilly; MD Mithun K. Chittilappilly; HQ Kochi, Kerala). FY26 revenue Rs.5,965.78 Cr, PAT Rs.308.33 Cr. Q1 FY27 (quarter to 30 Jun 2026): revenue Rs.1,810.65 Cr (+23.5% YoY), PAT Rs.130.25 Cr (+76.4%), EBITDA Rs.190.96 Cr, margin 10.5% vs 8.4% - all segments in double-digit growth (results approved 29 Jul 2026). Solar sits inside 'Inverter, Batteries & Solar Power Systems'. Day-1 file 14 Sep 2026: 7/10, ~22 ads, Lead Form dest, pitch_fit HIGH.

Live check 14 Sep 2026: vguard.in/solar returns 404 Page Not Found. The real solar page is vguard.in/sps. Every vguard.in product page still opens with a maintenance overlay dated 'till SUNDAY 10th November 2019', and the homepage carries a current 'website temporarily not accessible' notice. The SPS page claims National Vendor under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (2024), 49 years, 60 mn+ users, 325 service centres, 33 branches, 40,000+ partners - but names no rupee of subsidy, no price, no payback calculator. Modules listed: 545 Wp MonoPERC HC (21.10%), 580 TOPCon (22.47%), 585 (RS) TOPCon N-type GG with 30-yr linear output warranty - most of the catalogue is flagged Non-DCR, with only 540/550 (AX) Bifacial DCR variants. The only WhatsApp number on site, 9633503333, is service support. The D2C store vguard.com sells solar inverters (Smart Pro 1200 S Rs.8,199; inverter+battery combos Rs.22,950-27,499, 4.4-4.9 star reviews) - no rooftop kit, no panels.

Day-1 leak, confirmed: no COD/EMI or subsidy visibility in the ads, and now also a dead solar URL, a price-less SPS page, a lead form whose first question is 'How did you find our website?', and zero customer install UGC. Ad counts are Day-1 estimates. Never promise subsidy approval.
ad_intelligence: Ad Library is 30% of the leak. The other 70%: (1) does the landing match the hook, (2) can a buyer WhatsApp in under 5 minutes, (3) is there proof a neighbour installed, (4) is the form short, (5) does tracking fire on enquire/WhatsApp not just PageView. On 14 Sep 2026 V-Guard fails 1-4 on the live site - /solar is a 404 and /sps has no price, no rupee and no chat. That is why we audit the site, not just the ~22 creatives.

Meta (FB+IG) primary via corporate handle @vguardindia - no solar-only handle. Google Search/PMax on 'solar inverter price', 'rooftop solar Kerala'. Owned D2C: vguard.com (Shopify, 235 solar-tagged SKUs, EMI + UPI offers). Retail/dealer: 40,000+ partners, 325 service centres. Marketplaces: Amazon, Moglix, IndiaMART, SolarClue.

~22 creatives by Day-1 signature; group spend Rs.20 L+/mo with solar a small slice. Verify in Meta Ad Library India (active filter) + Google Ads Transparency (vguard.in / vguard.com). Do not quote 22 as a hard number - and split appliance/fan/stabiliser creatives out before reading solar ROAS.

Rooftop SPS (on-grid + off-grid + battery backup, free Wi-Fi data logger, export-limit support). Panels: 545 Wp MonoPERC HC 21.10%, 580 TOPCon 22.47%, 585 (RS) TOPCon N-type GG - 30-yr linear output / 12-15 yr product warranty; mostly Non-DCR, 540/550 (AX) Bifacial DCR available. On-grid inverter 97.60% peak efficiency. Store: Smart Pro 1200 S solar inverter Rs.8,199 (4.43/5, 21 reviews); combos Rs.22,950 / 26,299 / 27,499. No rooftop kW price anywhere on owned media.

Ad -> vguard.in/sps -> 'Partner with Us' form (End Consumer vs Institutional toggle, 'How did you find our website?' dropdown, 240-char message box). Product tiles have 'I am interested' / 'KNOW MORE'. Support: 0120-4850100, 1860-180-3000, 1800-103-1300, customercare@vguard.in, WhatsApp 9633503333 (service). Dealer locator exists; no city solar landing pages; no site-survey scheduler.

PM Surya Ghar is at 50.06 lakh homes / 16,185 MW installed, Rs.28,024 Cr paid by DBT, loans at 5.75%, 34,219 registered vendors (MNRE, Aug 2026) - the biggest demand pump in the category. V-Guard claims National Vendor status but publishes no Rs.30,000/60,000/78,000 math, no DCR-vs-Non-DCR eligibility note, and no terrace UGC. IndiaMART dealers quote V-Guard rooftop anywhere from Rs.26,000 to Rs.1,35,000/kW - the brand has ceded price narration to resellers.
findings: The paid click lands on a broken door (confirmed 14 Sep 2026). vguard.in/solar = 404 Page Not Found. vguard.in home shows 'Due to technical upgradation of our system, our website is temporarily not accessible'. Every product page still renders a maintenance overlay dated 'till SUNDAY 10th November 2019' with call-centre numbers. A Rs.5,965 Cr listed brand is sending high-intent solar traffic into that. Fix order: 301 /solar -> /sps, kill the 2019 overlay, then talk about creative.

Day-1 leak confirmed - no COD/EMI or subsidy rupee in the funnel. The SPS page says 'National Vendor under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (2024)' and then never mentions Rs.30,000 / Rs.60,000 / Rs.78,000, the 5.75% scheme loan, or net-metering payback. Meanwhile the vguard.com store proves the brand can do commerce messaging - No Cost EMI, 10% EMI saving, 1% UPI saving, MRP strike-throughs - on a Rs.8,199 inverter. That commercial language never reaches the Rs.1.5-3 lakh rooftop buyer.

No price, no calculator, and resellers own the number. Zero rooftop pricing on owned media, while IndiaMART/TradeIndia dealers publicly quote V-Guard rooftop between Rs.26,000 and Rs.1,35,000 per kW. Buyers who search 'V-Guard solar price' meet a dealer's number, not yours. A from-Rs. band plus a 3-field savings calculator (city, monthly bill, roof type) recovers that search intent and turns it into first-party leads.

DCR vs Non-DCR is unexplained - and it decides subsidy eligibility. The catalogue is mostly Non-DCR (545 MonoPERC, 580/585 TOPCon), with DCR only on 540/550 (AX) Bifacial. For PM Surya Ghar the household needs ALMM-listed, DCR-compliant modules. Not stating which SKU is subsidy-eligible creates cancelled orders at DISCOM stage and hands the objection to Waaree/Tata dealers. Put an eligibility badge on each module and in the ad copy - without ever promising approval.

WhatsApp exists, but only for complaints. 9633503333 is service support; the sales path is a form whose first field is 'How did you find our website?' and an 'Institutional/Project (Bulk Purchase)' toggle. A homeowner asking '3 kW kitna?' at 9pm will not fill that. Move to a 3-field form (city, phone, monthly bill) plus a click-to-WhatsApp sales line with a catalogue and auto-greeting; speed-to-lead under 5 minutes is the single biggest CPL lever in Indian residential solar.

Zero install proof against the strongest tailwind in the category. 49 years, 60 mn+ users, 325 service centres, 40,000+ partners, 30-year output warranty - and not one terrace video, net-meter bill or customer voice in the solar creative. PM Surya Ghar just crossed 50.06 lakh homes and 16,185 MW with 16,328 installs a day (MNRE, Aug 2026); the buyers are being convinced by other brands' UGC. 20 Malayalam/Tamil/Hinglish roof Reels using the existing service network is a two-week job.
competitors: Residential nav with CFA rupees on the first screen, DCR/ALMM stated per SKU, city pages, EMI and financing partners named.
You have deeper retail trust (325 service centres, 60 mn users) and never say the rupee. Match their subsidy math and you out-trust them.
Same D2C shelf as you, but they put kit pages, prices and marketplace links in the ad path.
Your vguard.com store already does EMI/UPI/No-Cost-EMI beautifully on inverters. Extend the same commerce UX to panels and rooftop kits.
Hero = 'Save Rs.1 Lakh', 3-field calculator, WhatsApp CTA, 15k+ Google ratings, locality install proof.
They convert the same Kerala/TN click faster with less brand equity. You need the calculator and WhatsApp, not a bigger budget.
Prices, reviews (4.4-4.9), EMI banners, working checkout - a real conversion asset.
Solar rooftop is not on it. The ad sends people to a maintenance-noticed corporate page instead. That is the cheapest fix in this audit.
wins: WIN 1 - 48 hours: make the landing page exist, then make it sell

301 vguard.in/solar to /sps and remove the 2019 maintenance overlay plus the 'temporarily not accessible' notice from all paid landing paths. On /sps first screen: 'Rooftop solar from V-Guard - households may be eligible for up to Rs.78,000 central assistance under PM Surya Ghar (MNRE process; V-Guard does not approve subsidy)', a from-Rs. per-kW band, and a click-to-WhatsApp sales number (not the 9633503333 service line). Cut the form to 3 fields: city, phone, monthly bill. Expected: stop 100% of the dead-click waste; 25-40% more qualified enquiries at the same spend.
WIN 2 - 7 days: subsidy + EMI creative, DCR badges, and a savings calculator

Rebuild the solar ad set around the two things V-Guard already owns and never says: money (No Cost EMI + PM Surya Ghar rupees) and warranty (30-year linear output, 325 service centres, lifetime on-site service). Add a DCR / Non-DCR subsidy-eligibility badge to 545 MonoPERC, 580 and 585 TOPCon, 540/550 AX Bifacial. Ship a 3-field savings calculator that captures the phone number before showing payback. Expected: 1.5-2x form completion and far fewer DISCOM-stage cancellations.
WIN 3 - 14 days: 20 terrace UGC Reels + 60-day retargeting + solar-only handle

Shoot 20 installs across Kochi, Thrissur, Coimbatore and Chennai using the existing service network: before/after roof, net-meter spinning backwards, customer reading the old vs new bill, in Malayalam / Tamil / Hinglish. Launch a solar-focused IG/YouTube destination instead of the corporate @vguardindia feed. Audiences: (i) /sps no-enquiry, (ii) calculator abandoners, (iii) 50% video viewers - 60-day windows, because rooftop is a 30-90 day decision. Expected: cheaper CPL, higher survey-to-order rate, and price narration taken back from IndiaMART dealers.
